evidence_requirements.internal: A frozen, grouped PLDD-UP test partition with no filename-family, perceptual-duplicate, source, plant, or capture-burst leakage into training or calibration; each provisional class must meet the configured support floor.
evidence_requirements.external: At least one source-locked field domain independent of PLDD-UP and training, containing all three provisional labels with the configured total and per-class support.
evidence_requirements.acceptance: Per-class accepted-set confusion counts at the frozen refusal threshold; unfiltered closed-set precision or headline accuracy is not a substitute.
evidence_requirements.ood: Wrong-crop, other-plant, unsuitable-view, unsupported potato condition, and non-plant cases with false-accept numerator and denominator, judged by the upper 95% Wilson bound.
evidence_requirements.calibration: Temperatures and the refusal threshold fitted only on the locked calibration partition, followed by untouched internal and external test ECE reporting.
evidence_requirements.device_and_int8: A hash-matched full-integer INT8 export, float-versus-INT8 field and accepted-risk parity, and non-emulated Android warm/cold timing evidence.
evidence_requirements.nepal: The expected locked Nepal potato field set must be independently labelled, source-locked, and explicitly pass before promotion can be reconsidered.

limitations: This is a standalone candidate-bundle policy for potato_pldd_up_provisional_v1; it does not modify or control that training experiment.
Only potato early blight, late blight, and healthy are provisional known labels. Other diseases, pests, deficiencies, mixed symptoms, wrong subjects, and unsuitable images remain open-set or refused.
PLDD-UP operational-field performance is Indian-domain evidence and is not treated as independent external or Nepal evidence.
Currently available independent public potato evidence is not assumed to satisfy all three exact labels or the support floors; missing or broad labels must fail closed rather than be relabelled.
Passing public internal, independent-external, acceptance, calibration, OOD, INT8, and device gates remains insufficient without locked independently labelled Nepal field evidence.
promotion_allowed remains false until agronomy, localized safety, Nepal field, export/runtime, and rollout reviews explicitly supersede this policy.
